newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia spot tin price eases on London falls.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia spot tin price eases on London falls.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price closed four cents lower at 13.79 ringgit ($5.48) a kg after a weaker London market prompted initial selling, traders said.
"There were some initial selling due to lower London prices," a trader said. There was an opening offer of 139 tonnes against bids of 88. Turnover was 129 tonnes, against 118 on Friday.
Buyers were mainly from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.

Traders said the near-term outlook depends a lot on the London market. "If London prices rebound tonight, the market will try to rise to the psychological level of 14 ringgit," a trader said. --Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5160 ringgit)
